title: Event log (the platform-internal name for the trace)
description: Per agent.md: 'Operative predications... accumulate in the event log and constitute the agent's history.' The event log is the agentic-platform-view of what the rest of the harness calls trace. They are the same JSONL EAVT sequence; event-log is the lens emphasizing it as the witness-record stream from which agent identities are reconstructed.
